The '''Kessel Run''' was a [[Complex]] obstacle used on a [[swoopchasing]] course. The Run was littered with the wrecks of [[Starship/Legends|starships]], debrus, and trash to create an obstacle-strewn course that tested the rider's ability to maneuver. An Outlaw-level variation was the [[Shooting Gallery]].<ref name="BSS" />
